coordinates: Blender model space, metres. +X lateral, +Y anterior, +Z proximal.
method: Explicit regions localized against source bone and soft-tissue surfaces in multiple views. Seeds are projected only within their specified region; no highest-vertex heuristic. Broad regions are representative subsets, not measured complete footprints.
